title: NRES-016 EF1 independent scenario-tree risk-envelope oracle
conformance_requirements: Nominal transition vectors are finite, non-negative and sum to one.
Risk-envelope flows satisfy local lower and upper bounds.
Outgoing flow equals node arrival mass.
Child arrival mass equals total incoming edge flow.
One action is selected per canonical observable history.
No hidden-state, latent-regime, future-observation or oracle-label leakage.
Service floors and resource conservation remain hard constraints.
Emitted observations equal the corresponding successor-history observations.
Outcome permutation leaves the objective unchanged.
Probability-splitting of an identical outcome leaves the objective unchanged.
lambda=0 and alpha=0 reduce to nominal expectation.
lambda=1 is rejected under the strict-monotonicity benchmark contract.
non_claims: No code implementation or Rust test execution is included in this specification-only increment.
Synthetic reference values are not real-world performance results.
No calibration or distributional coverage guarantee is claimed.
No SDDP-scale performance or SOTA superiority claim is made.
No operational readiness, emergency authority or certification is conferred.
